row: NLSSM The School of Sports Massage

Established in 2004 in London by Susan Findlay, NLSSM is the training ground for professionals wanting to develop and strengthen their soft tissue skills. We offer a Level 5 Qualification in Sports Massage and Remedial Soft Tissue Therapy as well as CPD short courses.

Our Level 5 Diploma is designed for anyone with a serious interest in pursuing corrective soft tissue therapy as a career.
We will take you from start to finish without having to do multiple massage courses at various levels, no prior Level 3 or 4 training necessary. It will give you the skills needed to practice as an independent professional therapist, work with elite sports athletes, or work within a medical hands-on health care team.

We’re proud of the reputation that NLSSM The School of Sports Massage holds within the industry and and that our graduates are highly sought after within both the sport and health industries. 

Find out more: https://www.nlssm.com/diploma/
